description: Defines data structures, classes, and constants related to codeblock metadata and segmentation in a communication system, including codeblock description, metadata, and segmentation configuration.

classes.name: codeblock_metadata
classes.description: Contains parameters describing a codeblock, including common transport block parameters and specific codeblock parameters.

classes.name: described_segment
classes.description: Represents an LDPC segment or codeblock with associated metadata and data storage.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Returns a reference to the segment's data buffer, asserting it has been constructed.

methods.name: get_metadata
methods.description: Returns the metadata associated with the codeblock.
